name: tech-digest
description: Tech news digest with Hacker News API, multiple RSS sources, and comprehensive coverage

steps.name: fetch-hacker-news
steps.prompt:
Get top stories from Hacker News using their API. This is FAST and RELIABLE (JSON API, not RSS).

Step 1: GET https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/topstories.json
- This returns an array of story IDs (numbers)
- Take the first 20 IDs from the array

Step 2: For each of the 20 IDs, GET https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/item/{ID}.json
- Make these requests in PARALLEL (all at once, not one by one)
- Each returns story details: title, url, score, by (author), time

Step 3: Filter results:
- Keep only stories with valid external URLs (not 'Ask HN' text posts)
- Keep top 15 by score (upvotes)
- Filter for tech-related content (skip pure political posts if possible)

Extract for each story:
- Title
- URL (to external article)
- Score (upvote count)
- Comment count (descendants field)
- Posted time

Return as structured list sorted by score. This should be fast - API responds in <1 second.

steps.name: fetch-tech-rss-feeds
steps.prompt:
Fetch tech news from RSS feeds. Fetch ALL in PARALLEL.

Primary Sources (fast, reliable):
1. TechCrunch: https://techcrunch.com/feed/
2. The Verge: https://www.theverge.com/rss/index.xml
3. Ars Technica: http://feeds.arstechnica.com/arstechnica/index
4. Wired: https://www.wired.com/feed/rss (check category)

Secondary Sources:
5. Engadget: https://www.engadget.com/rss.xml
6. Gizmodo: https://gizmodo.com/rss
7. CNET News: https://www.cnet.com/rss/news/ (check)
8. ZDNet: https://www.zdnet.com/news/rss.xml (check)

Fetch ALL feeds simultaneously. Skip any >15s. Don't retry failures.

For each working feed, extract recent articles (last 24h):
- Headline
- Brief summary or first paragraph
- Publication time
- Source name

Return what you successfully fetched, noting which feeds succeeded/failed.

steps.name: fetch-dev-news
steps.prompt:
Fetch developer-focused news. Fetch ALL in PARALLEL.

Sources:
1. Dev.to: https://dev.to/feed/
2. Echo JS: http://www.echojs.com/rss
3. CSS-Tricks: https://css-tricks.com/feed/
4. Smashing Magazine: https://www.smashingmagazine.com/feed/
5. InfoQ: https://www.infoq.com/feed/
6. The New Stack: https://thenewstack.io/feed/

Fetch ALL feeds simultaneously. Skip any >15s. No retries.

Extract recent development articles with:
- Headline
- Brief summary
- Source

Focus on: New frameworks, tools, best practices, tutorials.

Return structured list noting successful fetches.

steps.name: format-tech-digest
steps.prompt:
Create a comprehensive Tech Digest for Discord.

HACKER NEWS TOP STORIES:
{{hn_stories}}

TECH RSS FEEDS:
{{tech_rss}}

DEVELOPER NEWS:
{{dev_news}}

TASK:
1. Review all sources (HN API + RSS feeds + dev news)
2. Select the 12-15 most significant tech stories
3. Deduplicate: If HN and RSS cover same story, use HN (vetted by community) with RSS for context
4. Categorize:
   - 🤖 AI & Machine Learning (models, AI tools, LLM updates)
   - 🚀 Product Launches (new apps, devices, services)
   - 💻 Developer Tools (frameworks, languages, libraries)
   - 💰 Startups & Funding (major rounds, acquisitions)
   - 🔒 Security (vulnerabilities, patches, breaches)
   - 📊 Industry News (FAANG, major tech companies)

5. Write concise summaries (2-3 sentences each)
6. Note source (HN has 🔥 emoji for high engagement)

FORMAT:
```
💻 **Tech Digest — {date}**

**🤖 AI & Machine Learning**
• [Headline] — 2-3 sentence summary. *(Source: TechCrunch/Verge/HN)* 🔥 (if HN score >200)
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*

**🚀 Product Launches**
• [Product/App name] — What it does and why it matters. *(Source)*
• [Launch] — Summary *(Source)*

**💻 Developer Tools**
• [Tool/Framework update] — What's new. *(Source)*
• [Release] — Summary *(Source)*

**💰 Startups & Funding**
• [Company] raised $XXM — What they do and lead investor. *(Source)*
• [Deal/news] — Summary *(Source)*

**📊 Tech Industry**
• [Company news] — Summary *(Source)*
• [Strategic move] — Summary *(Source)*

*{X} stories from {Y} sources — OpenFang Tech Digest*
```

Rules:
- Keep under 2000 characters
- Prioritize HN stories (community-vetted)
- Include 🔥 for HN stories with 300+ upvotes
- Include direct URLs where relevant
- Focus on last 24h content
- Note if sources were limited

Make it useful for developers and tech professionals.
